FSC.map_affine_multivariateGaussian {m n : ℕ} (μ : FSC.Coord n) (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : Matrix.PosSemidef G)
  (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ) (b : FSC.Coord m) :
  MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun x => b + (FSC.lin A) x) (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian μ G) =
    ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (b + (FSC.lin A) μ) (A * G * A.transpose)

FSC.map_weighted_multivariateGaussian {n : ℕ} (μ ν : FSC.Coord n) (G L : FSC.Mat n) (hG : Matrix.PosSemidef G)
  (hL : Matrix.PosSemidef L) (a b : ℝ) :
  MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun p => a • p.1 + b • p.2)
      ((ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian μ G).prod (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian ν L)) =
    ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (a • μ + b • ν) (a ^ 2 • G + b ^ 2 • L)

FSC.map_add_sqrt_smul_multivariateGaussian {n : ℕ} (G L : FSC.Mat n) (hG : Matrix.PosSemidef G)
  (hL : Matrix.PosSemidef L) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
  MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun p => p.1 + √s • p.2)
      ((ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 G).prod (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 L)) =
    ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (G + s • L)

FSC.exists_unit_gram {n : ℕ} (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) :
  ∃ v, (∀ (i : Fin n), ‖v i‖ = 1) ∧ Matrix.gram ℝ v = G

FSC.map_gramVectors_stdGaussian {n : ℕ} (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : Matrix.PosSemidef G) :
  MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun z => WeakSimplex.Coord.ofFun fun i => inner ℝ (FSC.gramVectors G i) z)
      (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian (FSC.Coord n)) =
    ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 G
